dedupe_keys.name: coatingdet wind tower coating defect images

description: CoatingDet contains 5,416 high-resolution RGB images of coated wind-turbine tower components taken in production, with YOLO bounding boxes for defect and benign particle classes. The current Zenodo version two is public under CC BY 4.0 and supersedes an initial 2,697-image version. Its own description reports 2,526 annotated boxes and a metadata CSV with finer defect subtype labels. A modeller could train a coating-inspection classifier and use its outputs as condition inputs in a wind-tower digital twin or maintenance-resilience study. A caveat is that these are factory surface images, not time-series observations of in-service corrosion or structural failure. The two-class box labels collapse different defect types, and imaging conditions vary across cameras and test partitions. Mapping an image score to failure probability would require separate physical and longitudinal evidence. I read the Zenodo metadata and manifest, without downloading the 15 GB image archive, checking annotation quality, or training a detector. The companion code has a separate repository and software licence.
